System_Information.Title: Perez 2019 - Configuration C1
System_Information.Description: Four-step pressure swing adsorption cycle for CO2/N2 separation based on Perez et al. 2019, configuration C1. This is a standard PSA cycle configuration using 13X zeolite adsorbent. The cycle consists of feed, blowdown, evacuation, and pressurisation steps. During the feed step, a CO2/N2 mixture enters at the bottom of the bed and exits at the top. The blowdown step reduces pressure at the top outlet, followed by evacuation at the bottom to achieve deep vacuum conditions. Pressurisation occurs at the bottom inlet using the feed gas composition. This configuration represents a typical four-step PSA process for gas separation applications.
System_Information.Author: Sam Affleck
